testsuite.name: WebSocket — raw text and JSON against the echo server

testcase.name: send text, read it back
testcase.system-out: * wsUrl = 'ws://localhost:8090/echo' * session = karate.channel('websocket') * = wsUrl * session.start() * session.send('hello') * session.pop() == 'hello'

testcase.name: JSON in, JSON out
testcase.system-out: * wsUrl = 'ws://localhost:8090/echo' * JsonTextCodec = Java.type('io.karatelabs.ext.websocket.JsonTextCodec') * session = karate.channel('websocket') * = wsUrl * = new JsonTextCodec() * session.start() * session.send({ type: 'ping', seq: 1 }) * session.pop() == { type: 'ping', seq: 1 }

testcase.name: collect a stream of messages
testcase.system-out: * wsUrl = 'ws://localhost:8090/echo' * session = karate.channel('websocket') * = wsUrl * = 3 * session.start() * session.send('a') * session.send('b') * session.send('c') * session.collect() == ['a', 'b', 'c']
